launcher.notes: MICROSOFT ACCOUNTS ALWAYS LAUNCH PREMIUM - the launch command now carries your Microsoft token, uuid and name whenever a session is on record (exactly how the msmc engine feeds the Minecraft command line), so an added Microsoft account can no longer load as an offline account and premium servers stop rejecting your login. The silent session renewal at launch retries once automatically, and the log now states in plain words what the game gets and why. A hidden account flip is fixed too: an offline in-game login could quietly move the launcher's active account away from your Microsoft account and the next PLAY started offline - only same-kind in-game switches are followed now. Restart the launcher and accept the update prompt.

notes: Kinetrix Client 3.6.5 - in-game Microsoft sign-in RESTORED. The previous in-game sign-in sent Microsoft a redirect address it does not accept for this app id, so the sign-in page showed its 'unknown request' error and switching/adding Microsoft accounts in-game was impossible. The in-game flow now uses the same method as the launcher (msmc parity): a real Microsoft sign-in window opens, and on Edge/Chrome the game picks the result up the moment you finish signing in - hands-free. If no Edge/Chrome exists, the page still opens in your default browser and you paste the address you land on. Combined with launcher 2.8.1: add your Microsoft account in the launcher or in the game, press PLAY, and the game launches as your Microsoft account - premium servers work. Restart the launcher and accept the prompts.
